title: Kagamine Len — Brand New Street〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Akito and Toya!
Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...? Kohane and An aren't with you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah. We're just here to catch a break before practice starts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you helping MEIKO out today, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I sure am!
What'll it be, guys?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll have my usual.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, just give me one moment!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO! Akito and Toya are heeere!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting!
I've got the coffees you ordered.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This one's for you, Toya!
Here's yours, Akito, and feel free to use this milk and sugar!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Great, thanks... Huh?
What's with the orange juice...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's mine. MEIKO said I can take a break until our next customer comes in!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, is it cool if I join you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Then I'll take this seat.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. There's something I've been wanting to ask you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ask us?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. So, you're supposed to be moving up a year soon, right? I heard a bunch of stuff is supposed to change, but what's actually gonna happen?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's gonna happen...? We're gonna be second-years, and our classes will be different too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, I know that much...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm not talking about that!
I wanna hear something like... Something you don't think I'd know!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even then, I don't really know what else to tell you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As far as things that will change in the new school year, I suppose it would be getting new textbooks and having juniors at school.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, the part about getting juniors sounds interesting!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, so how do you feel about getting juniors?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How do I feel...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't know, to be honest.
In junior high, I couldn't even interact with people in my own year much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But now I'm a bit excited.
I think I'll finally get to feel like I have juniors.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh, nice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're nice and really smart, Toya, so I bet your juniors will rely on you a whole lot!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I would be happy to be that reliable senior.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
How about you, Akito?
How do you feel about getting juniors?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well... I think for me, it kinda feels like I'm getting more friends.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Friends? Not like, lackeys who'll do whatever you say or something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look here, you...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hahaha, c'mon, I'm kidding!
So, what else?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like the juniors I've interacted with the most were the ones on my soccer team...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we had our coach, so I wasn't doing stuff like teaching them or looking after them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So that's what you meant by feeling like they're friends instead of juniors...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But aren't the juniors the ones who put away all the equipment and clean up the field and all that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I guess it works that way in a lot of places.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I usually helped them.
Cleanup finished faster that way, and they'd stay back to do extra practice with me, so.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Huh, you were actually a good senior, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's nothing to call me a good senior over.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You think so? I figure you're a good senior just for not acting all high and mighty!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm, I'd like to be the junior to a senior like you guys!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm happy to hear you say so.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But are you okay with that? You won't be able to bite back at us if you're our junior.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's totally fine!
I mean, I bet you'd treat me nicer as your junior, and help me out with anything I ask!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's got you there, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
He's real sly when it comes to this kinda thing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe!
